svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: A disc 446 across, 10 thick, with a 60 mm feed hole in the centre.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Cut with a jigsaw to a scribed circle; file the edge smooth.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: The lid rests on the tub rim; it overhangs 8 mm all round.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Two over-centre clamps on the tub, 45 degrees each side of the

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: front, hook over the lid edge; no tools to open or close.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: The right-hand clamp's lever carries the interlock pin on the

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: brake cable: it cannot open unless the brake is set.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: The feed pipe stops 15 mm above the lid: the lid lifts straight

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: up and off without moving the hopper.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: with the clamps shut the lid cannot be lifted by hand.
